name: Spirit Wars 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Spirit Wars is a free-to-play fantasy idle RPG set in the vast, darkness-corrupted World Tree of Aeria. As a Savior summoned from another world, you will lead a growing legion of unique Guardians, each with their own personalities and abilities, to battle nightmarish enemies and purge the roots of evil threatening the world.
